title: WebSocket migration: acknowledged state and sequenced resume
requiredVisibleLabel: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Reconnect a versioned synthetic WebSocket from an acknowledged cursor, detect missing or duplicate effects, and judge state and sequencing against the original recovery budget.
preconditions: A browser supporting standard local HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
Fixed synthetic v1 sequences 1-3 acknowledged at cursor 3 and state 30.
Fixed synthetic v2 sequences 4-6 with a different envelope format.
No account, credentials, subscription, server, framework or live socket.
actions: Set bounded cursor, replay, delivery, decoder, state, observation and timing assumptions.
Start v1; cut over to v2; reconnect and inspect individual synthetic checks.
Check a prediction separately from user impact.
Start another attempt while retaining at most eight completed results.
Reset explicitly to the exact default configuration and empty history.
assertions: Acknowledged state and a complete ordered sequence survive safe resume.
Wire replays are detected separately from duplicate visible effects.
A skipped or missing sequence, out-of-order frame, state loss or decoder rejection interrupts.
The original disconnect-to-final-observation budget is inclusive and never restarted.
Missing cursor or observation stays unknown; a known failure still dominates partial uncertainty.
Invalid inputs and phase transitions cannot mutate configuration or silently discard history.

iac.decisionStage: Recorded after genuine loadable-stub behavioral RED and before implementation.
iac.reason: Resource-free local synthetic lesson. No cloud, IaC, scaffold, identity, deployment, expenditure or production-runtime work is authorized or needed.

limits: All messages, acknowledgements, state, traces and elapsed times are synthetic.
No actual WebSocket or host handoff, latency, transport guarantee or Azure result.
No identity or authentication behavior is simulated because it is not needed for this lesson.
History is in-memory only, bounded to eight results, and erased only by explicit reset or page reload.
This is one frozen S unit. Tests, evidence and publication earn no additional units.
B-S045 and original D-S045 native acceptance remain separate and unfulfilled.
No shared files, packages, framework, cloud resources, real credentials or unsafe browser flags.
